default.description: ComfyUI master, core nodes only, the model's official workflow with full-precision weights.
default.notes: Official image_ideogram4_t2i template without its LLM prompt-rewrite stage (the other rows take the case prompt as is). The DiTs are the model's official FP8 release (ideogram-ai/ideogram-4-fp8, the sglang row's weights) dequantized to BF16 by the harness exactly as sglang's weight-only FP8 linears compute them (dequant-fp8:). ComfyUI's own FP8 loader is not used because on sm90+ it runs an FP8 checkpoint as W8A8 -- Comfy-Org's fp8_scaled repack, per-tensor requantized, got activations quantized to FP8 in all 211 linears (2.7% relative error per linear against weight-only, 1.75x faster GEMMs; measured on B200 2026-09-26), a lossy class the other rows do not use. The text encoder is bf16 in place of fp8_scaled. Conditional + unconditional models through DualModelGuider, cfg 7 with the template's CFGOverride, i.e. two forwards on every step like sglang's V4_DEFAULT_20 preset. One GPU: the guidance branches run on two different models, which the CFG Split node does not cover. Weights are the full-precision single-file checkpoints ComfyUI loads (Comfy-Org repackaging or the model's own single-file release); the official template's fp8/int8/nvfp4 defaults are swapped out because they are a different numeric class from every other row. Sampler, scheduler and shift follow the official ComfyUI workflow; steps, CFG, size, frames and seed follow the case. Compile off: the first compiled request fails in SamplerCustomAdvanced with 'AssertionError: Expect size to be a plain tuple of ints but got torch.Size([1, s81])' (a dynamo dynamic-shape failure on this graph; ComfyUI 88ab4a06, B200, 2026-09-25), so the cell runs eager.

blackwell-gpuonly.description: Blackwell: the default graph with every model resident on the GPU (--gpu-only).
blackwell-gpuonly.notes: B200: --gpu-only keeps every model, text encoders included, stored and run on the card; a 183 GB B200 holds the largest graph here (MiniMax-H3: 62 GB DiT + 48 GB Qwen3-VL-32B + VAEs). Placement only, numerics unchanged. Measured 2026-09-25 on 1xB200, FLUX.1 eager, interleaved arms: default 5.94 / 5.77 / 5.79s against --gpu-only 5.56s and --gpu-only --disable-dynamic-vram 5.57s (Qwen-Image-2.1: 3.75 / 3.91 against 3.47 / 3.48) -- every --gpu-only arm below every default arm; disabling dynamic VRAM on top adds nothing, so the simpler flag is kept.
